title: A Cubic Separation Law for Wide Binaries: an Exponent With No Free Parameters
description: VERSION 3. THE s^3 PREDICTION, ITS FIVE FALSIFIERS AND THE FROZEN PRE-REGISTRATION ARE UNCHANGED. THE CLAIM, FIRST. In wide binaries wider than about 50 kAU the relative velocity should exceed the Newtonian value by an amount growing as the CUBE of the separation: gamma_v(s) - 1 = (1/2)[nu(y_ext) - 1] (omega_c^2/GM) s^3. The EXPONENT IS 3 -- derived, not fitted, not tunable. Every known contamination channel in wide-binary samples rises as s^(1/2) instead. Exponent 3 against exponent 0.5 is the measurement. WHAT WOULD KILL IT: no excess beyond ~50 kAU in a contamination-controlled sample; a log-slope inconsistent with 3; a knee that does not move as M^(1/3); an amplitude inconsistent with omega_c^2/GM; or a boost gamma_v ~ 1.09 found INSIDE 30 kAU. It cannot be measured with Gaia DR3 -- we checked the catalogue ourselves. WHAT IS NEW IN v3, and none of it changes the prediction. (1) THE COEFFICIENT IS A SINGLE RATIONAL. Writing 32pi as 8pi/kappa^2 and substituting Lambda = 8 pi G rho_Lambda / c^2, EVERY pi, the 32 and the 3 ALL CANCEL, leaving a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda) exactly with kappa = 1/2. So '32pi/3' is not a compound of three geometric factors -- it is what one statement looks like after being routed through Lambda and Einstein's 8pi. The framework's entire dimensionless content is the single RATIONAL kappa = 1/2, and the honest form of the open problem is 'why kappa = 1/2', not 'why 32pi/3'. Consequence stated against interest: the standing transcendence obstruction ('Z carries a transcendental sqrt(pi) while flavour data are algebraic') is correct about Z, but that sqrt(pi) belongs to GENERAL RELATIVITY'S 8pi, not to this framework, whose own number is rational. (2) THE ECCENTRIC-ORBIT ERROR BUDGET IS TIGHTENED BY TWO ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE -- the honest soft spot of v1 and v2. Real wide binaries are NOT circular, and off circles the eigenvector relation Box_u u = -Omega^2 u fails, so a CLOSURE must be chosen to reduce Box_u u_mu to the scalar argument of K. The prior verdict on that closure was 'free, bounded'. But the prior bracket was computed over time-weightings of |a|^2, which know nothing about Box_u. Using the action's ACTUAL Box_u u instead collapses the spread: on radial infall onto 1e12 Msun (the maximally non-circular case, a hard upper bound on eccentricity effects) the |a|^2-family gives nu = 1.170 / 2.364 / 7.837, a 570% spread, while the action Box_u family gives nu = 1.0004 / 1.0062 / 1.0797, a 7.9% spread -- a 72x narrowing; from 100 kpc it is 172% -> 0.9%, a 189x narrowing. So the off-circular ambiguity is <~8% in the worst case, not a factor of several, and the s^3 prediction is correspondingly sharp for ECCENTRIC pairs, which is what the Gaia DR4 shape test needs. TWO EXACT IDENTITIES, at matched local acceleration a and radius r: circular Box_u u/u = -Omega^2 = -a/R, radial infall Box_u u^r/u^r = 2GM/r^3 = +2a/r -- a factor 2 AND an opposite sign. STATED AGAINST INTEREST: the action does NOT eliminate the freedom, because Box_u u is NOT parallel to u off circles (spatial and time components differ by 8 to 5 orders along the infall), so a projection must still be chosen. The action narrows; it does not close. (3) AN INDEPENDENT CMB CHECK OF THE a0 FOOTING, WITH CREDIT WHERE IT BELONGS. This paper carries both footings throughout. The FORK ITSELF -- whether a0 couples to cH(z) or to the dark-energy density sqrt(8 pi G rho_Lambda/3) -- was posed and first decided long before this work: GNEDIN (2008), arXiv:0809.2790, states both options explicitly, tests them against high-z Tully-Fisher data to z = 1.2, and concludes that dark-energy coupling can be consistent while Hubble coupling requires unreasonable w -- 'this would appear to favor coupling to the dark energy density.' See also arXiv:0802.1526. WE ADD ONLY AN INDEPENDENT CHECK from a different epoch and different systematics, worth recording because Gnedin explicitly flagged possible unaccounted systematics. Since the acoustic acceleration is a_ac ~ c_s H, a rising a0 = cH(z)/Z makes H CANCEL, leaving y = Z/sqrt(3(1+R)) ~ 2.6-3.3 at EVERY epoch, so nu - 1 ~ 15% throughout the entire acoustic era rather than as a late correction. Propagated through c_s^2 = c^2/[3(1+R)] over CAMB's exact background (our sound-horizon integral reproduces CAMB's own r_star = 144.44 Mpc to 0.00%), this shifts theta_star by ~1.5% against Planck's 0.03% measurement -- EXCLUDED. The constant, rho_Lambda-tied footing shifts theta_star by 3e-7 and is CONSISTENT. Same verdict as Gnedin (2008), from the CMB rather than from Tully-Fisher. LIMITATION STATED: this is a background-plus-recombination treatment, NOT a modification of the Boltzmann perturbation hierarchy, and a fully relativistic MOND theory (AeST; Skordis & Zlosnik) already reproduces the CMB -- so the rigorous form of this question belongs to that theory, not to an a0(z) scaling argument. (4) A NEGATIVE RESULT: SIX CLOSED CLASSES IN THE SEARCH FOR WHAT FIXES kappa. An exhaustive sweep of conditions on the kernel's own spectral structure -- the Herglotz sum rule INT dmu/|t| = 1, K(0) = 0, ||K|| <= 1, retarded analyticity, the branch point at z = -1/4, thermal saturation against every forced kernel constant, and the location statistics (median, geometric mean) of the spectral measure -- found NONE that fixes kappa, because every committed condition is imposed at a scale-free point of the dimensionless axis z = Box_u/a0^2 and is therefore invariant under a0 -> lambda a0. Along the way: the spectral weight above the de Sitter frequency is exactly W = 1/(pi Z) = kappa sqrt(3/(8 pi^3)), LINEAR in kappa, so any forced weight would give kappa in one step -- but no forced condition supplies one. kappa's value is not derived. WHERE IT COMES FROM (unchanged from v2). The framework is MODIFIED INERTIA -- the modification is in the matter sector, not in gravity. CREDIT, PLAINLY: the interpolation nu(y) = sqrt(1+1/y) and the identity g_obs^2 - g_bar^2 = a0 g_bar ARE Milgrom (1999, Phys. Lett. A 253, 273) Eqs. (8)-(9) with coefficient 2cH_Lambda; Milgrom (1999, 2015) and Smolin (2017, PRD 96, 083523) had already tied a0 to Lambda with a 2pi coefficient. NO PRIORITY IS CLAIMED for the Lambda tie. What is ours is the coefficient cH_Lambda/Z, the modified-inertia completion, and this prediction. The second scale is a response gate K_eff = 1 - S(|a|/a0) G(omega), G = 1/(1+i omega/omega_c), omega_c in [1.782, 2.211]e-14 rad/s. WHY A GATE MUST EXIST, AND WHY ITS SCALE IS FREE: on the frequency axis |K| = 1 EXACTLY for every omega > a0/2c, so the kernel saturates with no high-frequency roll-off and gives an inner-disk star and the Earth the SAME response; since the solar system must be Newtonian and galaxies must not be, a frequency-dependent roll-off is REQUIRED -- the gate's existence is forced. Its SCALE is not: omega_c is a FREE PARAMETER, with every intrinsic scale of the theory 3.2-5.6 decades away and consistency alone bracketing it to only ~3 orders. THE BRANCH IS SETTLED FROM THE ACTION: Box_u u_mu = -Omega^2 u_mu identically on a circular orbit, so K's argument is the ORBITAL FREQUENCY; had it been |a| the gate would stay open and the prediction would be gamma_v ~ 1.09 instead. THE GATE IS SHUT WHERE EVERYONE MEASURES: a 1.5 Msun pair at 10 kAU has Omega 11x above the TOP of the omega_c window, giving gamma_v = 1.0004-1.0006, within 0.04 sigma of Newton; the dead zone r_gate/r_M = 4.54-7.76 means a pair can be sub-a0 yet gate-shut and must look NEWTONIAN, roughly 10 to 50-60 kAU for 1.5 Msun. GALAXIES ARE UNTOUCHED (largest Omega/omega_c is 0.364 across the MW solar circle, outer disk, dwarfs, LSB disks and massive spirals), which is what makes the gated reading admissible. THE EXPONENT COUNTS POLES: an n-pole gate gives s^(3n), verified numerically at n = 1,2,3 (slopes 3.00, 6.00, 8.99); the exponent is PARAMETER-FREE even though the amplitude is not. FEASIBILITY IS RESOLVED NEGATIVELY: at this paper's own cuts the El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) Gaia eDR3 catalogue holds only 436/270/155/60/24/3 pairs across 30->236 kAU (364 beyond 50 kAU) against a ~2000/bin requirement for 5-sigma shape separation, and relaxing the distance cut does not rescue it. GAIA DR4 IS THE ONLY ROUTE. PRE-REGISTERED AND HASH-STAMPED BEFORE THE DATA: Amendment 1 (2026-07-27, SHA-256 a309a502332b84ad521385b1c2031652849c9ce358c396f680f2308dd5ba1c13) records p = 3, records gamma_v = 1.0004-1.0006 inside 2-30 kAU so a NEWTONIAN DR4 RESULT IN THAT WINDOW CONFIRMS this branch rather than refuting it, and states that DR4 constrains the nu+EFE+gate prescription and NOT the value of a0 or Z. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED. Not a test of a0 or kappa: a confirmed s^3 rise establishes a frequency scale omega_c and a one-pole response. Z = 5.7888 and the conventional 2pi = 6.2832 differ by 7.87%, both sit inside the +/-16% empirical a0 box, and no arena here separates them; against interest, matching Chae (2024b)'s central gamma on this framework's own kernel needs a0 ~ 1.9x canonical, which at face value disfavours the Lambda-tied coefficient specifically. NOTHING about whether dark matter exists: a wide-binary result constrains the weak-field FORCE LAW, not the matter content, and gamma_v = 1 is Newton's prediction, shared by LambdaCDM, by this framework's own gated branch, and by modified-force-plus-particle hybrids. a0's value, kappa (equivalently Z), the sign s = -1 and omega_c are POSTULATED, NOT DERIVED. CORRECTIONS CARRIED FORWARD, recorded rather than quietly fixed: the 200-vs-30 kAU excess ratio is 7x not >10x; the fixed-separation mass scaling is asymptotic and knee-contaminated to M^-0.857 by 30 kAU; the operative sample requirement is ~2000 pairs/bin not ~265; omega_c is declared free. All numbers are printed by committed scripts, all exit 0, no hard-coded verdicts, both a0 footings and both omega_c edges throughout, at https://github.com/carlzimmerman/zimmerman-formula
